lessons.name: Choose the short u or long u word that matches the picture

contents.text: Vowels can be short or long. A long vowel says its name. A short vowel does not.

header.text: The letter u is a vowel. When u is followed by just consonants, u does not say its name. It makes a short u sound (/ŭ/).
When u is followed by a consonant and a silent e, u says its name. It makes a long u sound (/ū/).
When u is followed by another vowel, the two vowels can make a vowel team. In vowel teams that start with u, u says its name. It makes a long u sound. The other vowel is silent.

content.text: Listen and read along with the passage about bike sharing.

paragraphs.text: Do you need a quick and easy way to get around town? If so, then bike sharing might be for you. Bike sharing businesses allow you to pick up a bicycle where you need it. Then you can drop the bike off when you are done.

Bike sharing companies place bike stations all over town. They charge people a fee to use their bikes. People pay with cash or special cards. Sometimes people can even pay for a bike with their phones.

Bike sharing can be helpful in big cities. In cities, it is often hard to find a parking space for a car. So, instead of driving to a store or restaurant, people can simply take a bike. Bikes can also help people get to bus stops or train stations more quickly.
Bike sharing can be cheaper and easier than using a car. And it can be a fun way to get around the city.

content.text: Listen and read along with the passage about yard sales.

paragraphs.text: As the saying goes, "One person's trash is another person's treasure." This is definitely true of yard sales, which are also sometimes called garage sales. People often have yard sales to sell the things they no longer want or need in their homes. Shoppers find yard sales exciting because they never know what they may find.

Yard sales usually take place on weekends. People who love yard sales drive around neighborhoods looking for yard sale signs. When they see a front yard filled with things for sale, they stop to check it out.

Some yard sale hunters go early in the morning for the best finds. Other shoppers go to yard sales at the end of the day. They want to get a bargain from the sellers. So, they may offer a lower price. Usually, sellers will agree to a lower price just to get rid of an item.
No matter what time you go to a yard sale, you are likely to find good prices. And you just might find some "treasure," too.

content.text: Listen and read along with the passage about elevators.

paragraphs.text: Elevators have been around for hundreds of years. Early elevators were different from the ones today. But like today's elevators, they were based on a simple machine called a pulley. A pulley uses ropes or cables wrapped around a wheel to lift things.

Over the years, people found ways to make elevators better. Water and steam power were used to move the elevators up and down. But the elevators were not very safe for people to ride. Sometimes the ropes broke, and the elevator would plunge to the ground. That kind of quick drop could really hurt someone.

In 1853, a man named Elisha Otis came up with a way to make elevators safer. He added special parts that would stop an elevator if it started to fall. Thanks to Otis and his invention, builders were able to make buildings taller. People no longer had to worry about riding in elevators. They could just enjoy the ride!

content.text: Listen and read along with the passage about car washes.

paragraphs.text: The first car wash opened in Detroit, Michigan, more than one hundred years ago. If you wanted your car washed, you had to drive through a tunnel. A line of people in the tunnel washed, rinsed, and dried the car by hand. And when they were done, you drove away.

Car washes have changed since then. Today, car washes have machines that wash and dry cars. First, the driver drives the car onto a special rolling track. The track slowly moves the car through a tunnel while machines spray the car with soap and water. Giant brushes roll across the car to scrub off the dirt. Then, more water is sprayed on the car to wash off the soap. The car stops at the end of the track, and big fans blow hot air on the car to dry it.
After the machines clean the car's exterior, the outside of the car looks shiny and new. And if people want the inside of their car cleaned, many car washes can help with that, too.

content.text: Listen and read along with the passage about cruise ships.

Passengers can sit and enjoy beautiful views from the ship. They can also find ways to stay busy on board. There is plenty of fun for the family with places to eat, pools to swim in, and games to play. Some ships even have ice skating rinks and movie theaters.

Passengers do not have to remain on the ship the whole time, though. Cruise ships stop at different places, such as little island towns or large seaside cities. The ships pull into these ports and let the passengers off. The people shop in the town or see the sights during the day. In the evening, they return to the ship and sail away.

content.text: Listen and read along with the passage about vending machines.

paragraphs.text: Vending machines offer a way to purchase things when you are not near a store. You can buy headphones, school supplies, and even pizza from vending machines. But that was not always the case.

The first vending machines just sold chewing gum, candy, and peanuts. People put a penny in the machine and pulled a lever. Pulling this long bar caused a door on the machine to open. The treat fell out of the door and into the person's hand.

Some people learned they could trick the machine, though. The machine would still give them a treat if they put in a fake coin. Laws were passed to stop people from doing this. New vending machines were also made. These new machines would not take fake coins.

Now, people push a button on a vending machine to choose what they want. Computers count the money and work the motors that push out the snacks. And this all happens in seconds, so you can quickly grab a snack or cold drink!
